title: Time clock
description: Punches from the Hikvision time clocks. They are copied every 5 minutes; the API only reads from the clocks.

status.title: Time clocks sync
status.readOnly: Read-only: the API never changes the clocks' configuration.

messages.notConfigured: The API has no clock user (CHECADOR_USER): nothing is synced.
messages.sinRelojes: No time clocks have been added yet.
messages.paused: A clock rejected the password and its sync was paused. Update CHECADOR_PASS in the API and restart it.
messages.running: Syncing: {{leidos}} of {{total}} events reviewed · {{nuevas}} new punches · {{restantes}} left
messages.error: A clock failed on its last sync; see which one below.
messages.pending: The first sync has not finished yet.

reloj.pending: Its first sync has not finished yet.

sync.hint: Pulls everything still missing from each clock (the full backlog). Runs in the background; you can keep using the system.
sync.alreadyRunning: Every clock is already syncing; wait for them to finish.

import.hint: Pulls every punch in the selected date range from all the clocks. It may take several minutes; you can keep using the system.

otroHint: Not a valid punch (device code {{minor}}). It does not count for attendance.

errors.status: Could not load the time clock status

reporte.title: Time clock entries/exits
reporte.description: Shifts built from the time clock punches and matched to each employee by their time clock number.
reporte.sinVincular: The {{count}} unlinked ones show the time clock name and the “Not linked” mark.
reporte.regla: The time clock does not tell entries from exits: punches alternate, repeats within 5 min are ignored and a shift lasts at most 13 h.

empleados.title: Time clock employees
empleados.description: Match each time clock number to its system user. The clock prefixes the area to the number (070562 = payroll 562), so the link is confirmed here.

relojes.title: Time clocks
relojes.description: Add the time clocks and check their configuration and sync. The system only reads from the clocks.
relojes.readOnly: Read-only: the system connects to the clocks to read their punches and configuration; it never changes anything on them. Only punches (face, fingerprint or card) are read, not door openings.
relojes.credenciales: It connects with the clock user and password configured in the API (the same for every clock).
relojes.notConfigured: The API has no clock user (CHECADOR_USER / CHECADOR_PASS): it cannot connect to any clock.
relojes.empty: No time clocks have been added yet.

uso.hint: If it counts, its punches build the shifts together with the other clocks that count: the first punch of the shift is the entry and the last one the exit, whatever the clock (people may enter through one and leave through another). If it does not count, its punches are stored and shown in the table, but not used for entries/exits or overtime.

config.title: Clock configuration
config.hint: Read live from the clock, without changing anything.
config.personasDetalle: {{conRostro}} with face · {{conHuella}} with fingerprint · {{conTarjeta}} with card
config.desfaseHint: Set the time on the clock itself (preferably with NTP). If the clocks disagree, an entry on one and an exit on another add or remove worked time.

dialog.urlHint: The IP or the address you open in the browser to log into the clock.
dialog.nombreHint: Leave it empty to use the name configured on the clock.
dialog.altaNota: The system connects to confirm the address and starts pulling its punches. It does not change the clock.
dialog.bajaTexto: It stops syncing. Its punches stay and, if you add it again, it resumes where it left off. It does not change the clock.
dialog.editarNota: It only changes how the system uses this clock's punches. It does not change the clock.

toasts.alta: {{nombre}} added: it is already pulling its punches

errors.status: Could not read the clocks status
errors.config: Could not read the clock configuration
